residual.op.embedding.desc: Looks up a learned row of numbers for each token. Set its width to V and the rows become scores for the next token: a bigram model.
residual.op.position.desc: A learned vector for every position in the context, so later machines know where each token sits. Takes no input.
residual.op.linear.desc: Multiplies every vector by a learned matrix and adds a learned bias: y = xW + b.
residual.op.activation.desc: Bends every number through a nonlinear function. Without one, stacked linear layers collapse into a single layer.
residual.op.add.desc: Adds its two inputs. As a residual connection it lets a layer refine its input instead of replacing it, and gives the gradient a short way back.
residual.op.multiply.desc: Multiplies its two inputs number by number, so one signal can open or close the other.
residual.op.norm.desc: Rescales each vector to a steady size, then applies a learned gain. Keeps deep stacks well-behaved.
residual.op.matmul.desc: Multiplies two grids of numbers. With transpose on, it compares every query with every key.
residual.op.scale.desc: Multiplies by a constant. 1/√d stops attention scores from growing with the vector width.
residual.op.causal_mask.desc: Blanks out the scores for later positions, so each token can only look back.
residual.op.softmax.desc: Turns a row of scores into weights that are positive and sum to one.
residual.op.split_heads.desc: Cuts each vector into several heads that can attend to different things.
residual.op.merge_heads.desc: Joins the heads back into one vector per position.
residual.op.shift.desc: Delays the sequence by a few steps, so each position sees an earlier token.
residual.op.concat.desc: Joins two vectors end to end.
residual.op.attention.desc: Multi-head causal self-attention in one machine: queries, keys and values, scores, mask, softmax and the output projection.
residual.op.mlp.desc: Two linear layers with an activation between them: widen, bend, project back.
residual.op.transformer.desc: One transformer layer: normalize, attend, add back; normalize, feed forward, add back.
residual.lesson.counting.title: Counting Pairs
residual.lesson.counting.brief: Guess the next letter of a word from the letter before it. Wire the Core's front into an Embedding Table set to width V, and the table's output back into the Core. Training fills the table with letter-pair statistics.
residual.lesson.case_shape.title: The Wrong Shape
residual.lesson.case_shape.brief: Someone built this model in a hurry and it won't start. Press Check, read what the Core expects, and find the machine that disagrees.
residual.lesson.context.title: More Context
residual.lesson.context.brief: One letter says little about the next. Let the model see several: Delay Lines bring earlier letters forward, a Concatenator joins them, and a Linear Layer with an Activation learns from the combination.
residual.lesson.case_diverge.title: Exploding Loss
residual.lesson.case_diverge.brief: The machine is sound, yet training blows up within a few steps. Watch the curve and find the setting responsible. Nothing in the machine needs to change.
residual.lesson.recall.title: Looking Things Up
residual.lesson.recall.brief: Letter–digit pairs, then a query letter: answer with its digit. The pair could be anywhere, so no fixed window works. Build attention by hand: queries meet keys, softmax picks the match, its value is read out.
residual.lesson.case_leak.title: Too Good to Be True
residual.lesson.case_leak.brief: This model's loss falls far below what any honest model reaches, yet the words it writes are no better than an honest model's. Something lets it see what it is supposed to predict.
residual.lesson.reverse.title: Knowing Where
residual.lesson.reverse.brief: Write a string of digits backwards. Attention compares contents but can't tell first from last: add a Position Table. Wrap attention and a Feed-Forward Block in Normalizers and Residual Junctions.
residual.lesson.case_order.title: Lost in Order
residual.lesson.case_order.brief: A complete transformer layer that still can't reverse a string. It can compare any two tokens, yet something the task depends on escapes it.
residual.lesson.case_depth.title: Too Deep to Learn
residual.lesson.case_depth.brief: Six layers deep and barely learning. Use the Inspect tab to follow the gradient down the stack, then give it an easier way through.
residual.lesson.induction.title: Induction Heads
residual.lesson.induction.brief: When a run of letters repeats, continue it. Delay Lines are off-limits, so two attention layers must cooperate: one notes what came before each letter, the next finds the earlier copy and reads what followed.
residual.lesson.language.title: Language
residual.lesson.language.brief: Everything together. Feed an Embedding Table plus a Position Table through a stack of Transformer Blocks, then a Normalizer and a Linear Layer: a small GPT. Train it on Shakespeare.
